title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news because they are reading the wrong things.
body:
It is not that there is too much information out there. It is that most of it is irrelevant to your actual life. When you scroll through a standard news feed, you are fighting against an algorithm designed to grab your attention with outrage or noise, not to help you understand the world.

True information is useful. It helps you make better decisions, understand your industry, or simply connect the dots on events that actually affect your day to day. But to get there, you need to filter out the clutter.

Personalization is not about creating an echo chamber or hiding things you disagree with. It is about removing the noise so you can focus on the signals that matter. When you tailor your feed to your specific interests and professional needs, you stop reacting to headlines and start building a real, nuanced understanding of current events.

We built Headlinne to prioritize your time and your curiosity. It is news that treats you like an adult who has things to do.
cta: You can see how we are changing the way people read at HEADLINNE.com.
